messages:
Marta: FYI vendor hit customs hold on a partial H100 shipment to FRA, need quick decision on RMA vs expedite replacement. PO RWI-2026-07.
Liam: ugh. what caused the hold? missing docs?
Elena (VertexLogistics): Hi team — customs flagged missing end-use cert + HS reclassification for a subset (4/12) units. We can either: (A) clear with docs (2-3 business days) or (B) air-expedite replacements from our DE pool with extra freight + brokerage.
Jordan: what's the delta on (B)? ballpark numbers so we can decide.
Elena (VertexLogistics): Ballpark add-on = +€9,000 per air AWB for expedited 4-unit pallet (incl. priority handler + brokerage) OR we can split: expedite 2 units, clear 2 via docs.
Marta: cluster impact: we lose ~40% of EU H100 capacity if those 4 are offline. ops-bot: capacity-drop alert -> eu-inference-pool down 38% for low-priority lanes.
ops-bot: ALERT: 2026-07-27 09:14 UTC - EU inference pool degraded. Suggested mitigation: route <v2-small> to other regions, mark <v2-large> as degraded.
Liam: if we redirect traffic to US it's going to add 30-60ms for customers in EU. Cost vs latency tradeoff. Any chance vendor can give loaner H100s from nearby depots?
Elena (VertexLogistics): We have a loaner pool in NL but it's tied to existing SLA contracts; we can loan 2 units for 14 days for a fee (~€3,200 total) + return logistics. Still need serials and signatures.
Ken (Customs): For faster clearance, provide: 1) end-use cert, 2) proforma with HS code 8542.31.90, 3) vendor VAT reg #. If submitted before EOD we can try same-day release.
Jordan: can procurement produce that proforma now? @Pat can you confirm VAT # and attach proforma?
Pat: on it. attaching draft proforma now.
Pat: PROFORMA snippet:
```
PO: RWI-2026-07
Items: 4x H100-48GB
HS: 8542.31.90
Value: EUR 0 (warranty replacement) - note: vendor to include replacement valuation for customs
Vendor VAT: NL123456789B01
```
Liam: Marta — if we accept expedite (B) + 2 loaners, total delta = €9,000 + €3,200 = €12,200 plus return shipping. Approve?
Marta: Approve up to €13k for expedited mitigation to meet latency SLOs. Prioritize 2 loaners + expedite 2 replacements.
Elena (VertexLogistics): Copy. We will: 1) start loaner paperwork for 2 units (pickup NL), 2) book express AWB for 2 replacements, 3) submit revised proforma for the other 2 to customs. ETA: loaners 24-36h, AWB replacements 48h excl. customs.
Elena (VertexLogistics): Need serials for the 4 units for RMA tagging and LOA. Please paste list.
Jordan: serials below (from staging manifest):
- SERN-FF12-001
- SERN-FF12-002
- SERN-FF12-003
- SERN-FF12-004

Marta: Also add internal tag: RMA-RWI-07-2026 so returns team can match.
Elena (VertexLogistics): Got it. I'll generate return labels for the 2 units cleared by docs and LOAs for the 2 loaners. AWB placeholders:AWB-EUR-945612 and AWB-EUR-945613 (expedite).
Ken (Customs): Once proforma is uploaded make sure to include 'temporary replacement — return within 30 days' language to speed brokerage.
Pat: uploaded proforma PDF to vendor portal and emailed customs contact (Ref: CUS-2026-154).
ops-bot: NOTE: Routing rule update applied — traffic to <v2-large-eu> will route to us-east as fallback until further notice.
Liam: ops — add a keystroke to feature flags so internal tests don't hit degraded nodes.
Marta: Good catch. @procurement we will reconcile extra cost to PO as amendment. Pat, please create amendment doc.
Pat: creating PO amendment, will attach signature sheet.
Elena (VertexLogistics): Quick heads-up on returns: vendor requires DOA photo evidence for warranty RMA. Please capture depot photos when receiving returns.
Jordan: noted. We'll do inbound photo + serial scan.
Marta: final ask — if loaners are delayed, fallback plan is to spin up 3x g5x temporarily in eu-west for training lanes; cost is ~€700/day but avoids customer-facing latency. Keep that as Plan C.
Liam: ack. monitor ops-bot for capacity changes.
Elena (VertexLogistics): Will confirm AWBs and final cost breakdown by EOD CET.
Marta: thanks — we'll stand by. :thumbsup:
Elena (VertexLogistics): thanks all, will update.
